sal.basis: Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, 8 yrs, Dublin, base salary (bonus excluded). Irish recruiter salary guides for 2025-26 (Morgan McKinley, Hays, Robert Half, Barden, Lincoln Recruitment) put a Dublin Senior Financial Analyst or Senior FP&A Analyst in industry at roughly EUR 65k-80k base, with FP&A Manager at about EUR 85k-100k+. These ranges come from prior knowledge, because live checks were not possible in this run (medium confidence). Chosen current base is about EUR 72k a year (EUR 6,000 a month); f = 6,000 / 26,000 = 0.2308. Noura's 34,000 SAR expectation maps to about EUR 7,850 a month (about EUR 94k a year), the top of the senior range and the entry point for FP&A Lead or Manager roles, which suits a qualified analyst with 8 years' experience.

rule.en: If you need a permit, we skip Irish jobs that say they can't sponsor or that pay below the permit salary minimum.
rule.ar: إذا كنت بحاجة إلى تصريح عمل، نتجاوز الوظائف في أيرلندا التي تذكر أنها لا تقدّم الرعاية أو التي يقل راتبها عن الحد الأدنى المطلوب للتصريح.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un permis, nous écartons les offres en Irlande qui excluent tout parrainage ou dont le salaire est inférieur au minimum exigé pour le permis.

desc.en: Most employers can hire someone on an employment permit only if at least half of their staff are EEA nationals, and General Employment Permit roles usually must first be advertised to EEA jobseekers for 28 days. Critical Skills roles skip the advertising step. None of this applies if you don't need a permit.
desc.ar: لا يمكن لمعظم جهات العمل توظيف شخص بتصريح عمل إلا إذا كان نصف موظفيها على الأقل من مواطني المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية، وعادةً ما يجب أولاً الإعلان عن وظائف تصريح العمل العام للباحثين عن عمل من المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية لمدة 28 يوماً. أما وظائف المهارات الحرجة فلا تحتاج إلى هذا الإعلان. ولا ينطبق أي من ذلك إذا لم تكن بحاجة إلى تصريح.
desc.fr: La plupart des employeurs ne peuvent recruter une personne avec un permis de travail que si au moins la moitié de leurs salariés sont ressortissants de l'EEE, et les postes relevant du General Employment Permit doivent en général d'abord être proposés aux candidats de l'EEE pendant 28 jours. Les postes Critical Skills sont dispensés de cette publication. Rien de cela ne s'applique si vous n'avez pas besoin de permis.

sensitive.notes: Irish CVs and application forms leave out photo, date of birth, marital or family status and nationality. The Employment Equality Acts 1998-2015 ban discrimination on nine grounds (gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race including nationality, and membership of the Traveller community), and candidates can take claims to the Workplace Relations Commission, so asking is risky. Forms do routinely ask whether you need an employment permit or sponsorship, and non-EEA candidates often list their stamp (e.g. Stamp 4); the rights card covers that, not a nationality field. Public-sector forms (publicjobs.ie) ask about EEA eligibility, which the rights card also covers. US multinationals in Ireland sometimes show voluntary diversity questions; these are optional, so we do not ask. If the product later wants to fill them, 'eeo' is the closest mode.

privacy.fr: Vos données sont protégées par le RGPD et la loi irlandaise de 2018 sur la protection des données (Data Protection Act 2018), sous le contrôle de la Data Protection Commission, et vous pouvez les télécharger ou les supprimer à tout moment.

renewal.en: Renews automatically at the end of each plan until you cancel, which you can do any time in Settings. Under EU and Irish consumer law you can withdraw within 14 days of buying for a refund, minus any service already provided.

renewal.fr: Renouvellement automatique à la fin de chaque formule jusqu'à résiliation, possible à tout moment depuis les Paramètres. Selon le droit européen et irlandais de la consommation, vous pouvez vous rétracter sous 14 jours après l'achat et être remboursé, déduction faite du service déjà fourni.

Je pilote le reporting IFRS et FRS 102 (normes irlandaises) et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et je recherche un poste d'analyste financier senior ou en FP&A à Dublin, sur site ou en hybride.

culture.notes: Work week Mon-Fri, a standard 39 hours; hybrid (2-3 office days) is the norm for Dublin finance roles, and the Work Life Balance and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 2023 gives a right to request remote work. Salaries are quoted gross per year, often 'plus bonus, pension and health insurance'; auto-enrolment pensions (My Future Fund) started on 1 Jan 2026. Professional roles are usually paid monthly. Notice is contractual: typically 1 month for analysts and 1-3 months for managers (the statutory minimum for an employee who resigns is only 1 week after 13 weeks' service), and recruiters ask for it up front. CVs: 2 A4 pages, reverse-chronological, short profile at the top, no photo, date of birth or marital status; non-EEA candidates usually state their stamp or permit status on the CV. Cover letters are optional on most ATS and LinkedIn applications, but public-sector roles (publicjobs.ie) use competency-based application forms. Qualification status ('ACA/ACCA/CIMA qualified', 'newly qualified' or 'part-qualified') is a standard screening question, and US multinationals often ask for US GAAP and SOX experience. Specialist agencies (Morgan McKinley, Hays, Robert Half, Barden, Lincoln Recruitment, Sigmar) fill a large share of FP&A roles. New starters need a PPS number for payroll.
